interface.shortDescription: Per-file pure-LOC limits with measured, file-specific extraction plans
interface.longDescription: Counts pure lines of code with tokei, enforces a per-file limit (default 350) with per-glob overrides and ignores, and — when files are over the limit — reads each one and proposes concrete extractions whose savings are measured with tokei rather than estimated. All arithmetic lives in a tested Node script, so no number in the report comes from the model. Config is shared with the Claude Code plugin at .claude/loc-guardian.local.md.
defaultPrompt: Use $loc-guardian-scan to check this repo's per-file LOC limits.
Use $loc-guardian-init to set a LOC limit and extraction rules for this project.
Use $loc-guardian-scan typescript src to scan only TypeScript under src.
